wallStrategy: Brick outer leaf, insulated cavity and load-bearing blockwork inner leaf. Owner confirmed 26 October 2026. Leaf strengths, thicknesses, cavity, ties and support remain to be designed.
workshopStrategy: Retain the separate 215 mm solid masonry architectural concept; its roof, lintels and foundation still need engineering.

sources.title: IStructE - structural engineering for domestic clients
Approved Document C - site preparation and moisture

walls: Reconcile cavity-wall thickness with fixed external and internal faces
Masonry strengths, slenderness, restraint and wind
Concentrated bearings, padstones, ties and movement joints
Trace every wall load through floors to foundations
openings: Confirm clear opening and actual bearing masonry on site
Tributary floor, roof and masonry loads including point loads
Lintel or beam selection, deflection, bearing and padstones
Outer-leaf support, cavity tray, damp proofing and fire protection
floors: Choose floor system and support lines before setting joist direction
Dead, imposed, partition and concentrated loads
Bending, shear, deflection, vibration and robustness
Stair/rooflight trimming, hangers, bearings and service zones
roof: Load paths for hips, ridge, dormers and rooflights
Loft courtyard projection and torsion/deflection at glazed faces
Connections to the existing roof and wall supports
concrete: Site investigation, groundwater and adjacent foundation levels
Earth, water and surcharge loads; flotation and settlement
Wall/slab thickness, bending, shear, crack width and reinforcement
Waterproofing, joints, penetrations and maintainable drainage
Temporary support and excavation sequence designed by specialists
steel: Set support arrangement and complete gravity/lateral load path
Section capacity, buckling, deflection and connections
Fire and corrosion protection; fabrication dimensions after survey

coordinationItems.title: House wall build-up
coordinationItems.detail: The visual model contains thin single wall shells. Reconcile brick/cavity/blockwork thickness before freezing room sizes or ordering lintels.

coordinationItems.title: Basement and existing foundations
coordinationItems.detail: Investigate soil, groundwater, drains, tree influence and adjacent foundations. No safe excavation, retaining-wall thickness, footing size or reinforcement is established.

coordinationItems.title: Large openings and transfer loads
coordinationItems.detail: Glazed courtyards, garage openings and the chamfered garden room require support and stability design. A window frame is not assumed to support the floor or masonry above.

coordinationItems.title: Continuous roof and 720 mm projection
coordinationItems.detail: Coordinate ridge/hip/dormer support and cantilever backspan with a structural engineer while retaining the accepted flat-ceiling route.

coordinationItems.title: Floor depth and stair headroom
coordinationItems.detail: The checked architectural headroom is only about 2.01 m in places. Engineered floor depths, finishes and tolerances may require layout adjustment.

coordinationItems.title: Quantities and completeness
coordinationItems.detail: Model opening heads are candidates, not a complete lintel order. Whole-house brick/block quantities await leaf geometry, verified openings, movement joints, below-ground work and waste allowances.
